analysis: The only change in this file is one added line in acquireResliceGate (head ~line 305): `resliceGateGeneration &+= 1`, a wrapping increment right after `isReslicing = true`. The acquire/release logic itself is unchanged: loop on isReslicing with continuation waiters, set the flag, then release resumes all waiters. The increment is actor-isolated and wrapping, so it cannot trap on overflow. It does not alter KV grant arithmetic, serviceability-floor checks, shrink/restore/regrow ordering, the weight-release ordering on failed loads, or any prefix-cache/SSD code. T-041's affected-file reference to this file concerns the cache budget and carve plumbing (makeEngineV2BundleForSlot passing modelArtifactSHA256 and cacheEligibleWeightHash to the factory), and none of that changed. No new data exposure, authorization, encryption or attestation surface. Remaining integration question (outside the supplied evidence): where resliceGateGeneration is declared in ProviderLoop.swift and how it is consumed, for example to detect that the slot set changed across a suspension. If a consumer uses it to skip or validate re-slice snapshots, its correctness matters for the sum-of-grants-within-budget invariant, but nothing in this diff shows a regression.
